bead.title: installer: add CI-runnable shell integration test for install.sh (rc-file idempotency, PATH update, retry)
bead.description:
AR-2026-05-17-repo finding. FEAT-007 AC-04/05/06 mention shell-based acceptance tests, but only Go unit tests for the update binary exist. Add a CI-runnable shell harness that exercises install.sh against a clean PATH and asserts: artifact selection per platform/arch, idempotent PATH update (bash/zsh/fish), and safe re-run.

Source review: fizeau-5b2a8950.
bead.acceptance:
1) A scripts/install/test-install.sh (or equivalent under tests/) runs install.sh against an isolated HOME and FIZEAU_INSTALL_DIR.
2) Assertions cover: binary lands at FIZEAU_INSTALL_DIR, rc-file mutation is idempotent across bash/zsh/fish, re-run does not duplicate PATH entries.
3) The script runs in CI on linux+darwin matrices (or is invoked from an existing workflow).
